content.text: **33/33 green.** Checkpoint 2B (the `.caos-expr` grammar collapse) is done and verified — and notably **without a redeploy**, which confirms the change was seed-key-preserving as reasoned. ## What landed in 2B **Typed arg vocabulary** (`parse_arg`/`ArgType`): renamed `:tree=`→`:hash=` (generalized to tree *or* blob by oid) and added `:docker=` (stores blob `docker://`). Wired resolution into both `build_arg_entries` (CLI/worker) and the evaluator. **`.caos-expr` grammar collapse** (`eval.rs`): `eval_command` no longer takes a positional image or `--`; every token after `run`/`curry` is a typed arg, and the reserved `--base` names the worker. `resolve_expr_image` (which sniffed `docker://`/hash/path) became `resolve_expr_base`, dispatching on the **explicit type** — no more sniffing on that surface. `resolve_expr_args` now handles `:docker=`/`:hash=` too. **Migrated every `.caos-expr`**: all 14 committed ones (`run -- …` → `run --base:=… …`, docker sentinels → `--base:docker=`, the multi-line `llm-step` curry/variable form), plus the runtime-generated fixtures in `tests/{eval-path,secrets,deep-deps}/cli.sh`. Fixed stale comments/doc. ## Why it was low-risk - The collapse produces **byte-identical arg trees** (base entry + args unchanged), so the seed keys the outer stack answers during orchestration held — hence no redeploy. - It's **isolated from the CLI/worker `caos` sniffers** (`resolve_run_image`/`resolve_cli_image`), which I deliberately left for a follow-up checkpoint. So `caos-cli run ` and `caos curry ` still use their positional grammar — that's why the tool scripts and most test `cli.sh` needed no changes. ## Remaining for "full collapse, no sugar" A **2C** checkpoint: collapse the **CLI** (`caos-cli run [output] -- --base:…`) and **worker `caos`** (`curry`/`run-then`/`map-then`) grammar, deleting the last sniffers and typing the map-then image positions (`--map`/`--run`/`--then`). Then **stage 3/4** is `:@@=` (remote git refs) — the actual consumer-story payoff. Want me to update `design/flake-inputs.md` with 2B-done + the 2C/3 pointers, and continue into 2C?
